notes: Only n_o was assigned. All other value fields are unassigned placeholders. The General Method explicitly gives forty subjects for Experiment 5, and the Experiment 5 Method refers back to it. However, the critical Probe type result is printed as F (1, 108) = 79.32, with exposure duration as a four-level between-subject factor. The stated subject count and critical-model degrees of freedom cannot be reconciled from the supplied source. Analytic N is therefore null; 40 is a source-printed candidate, not asserted as final analytic N. No N was inferred from degrees of freedom and no group sum was performed. Target identification is secure independently of the unresolved sample size. Rendered PDF pp. 322 and 338 confirm the printed count and degrees of freedom. No original effect size, p, replication field, or success verdict was assigned for completion.
